messages:
Elena M: Hi team — corporate card declined at client dinner tonight in SF, had to pay with personal card. Need to confirm fast reimbursement flow, and whether alcohol on the receipt is allowed.
Jon R: Ugh, sorry that happened. Do you have the merchant receipt and a note from the client confirming the dinner? We need itemized receipt (no photos of the card terminal alone).
Elena M: Attached photo of receipt in the expense app. Total $312.45, includes a $75 wine bottle (shared across 4 people). Card declined message showed "DECLINED" at checkout. No terminal slip showing auth.
Sam T: Two things: 1) Finance can fast-track emergency personal-pay reimbursements if you file EXP-FAST and attach receipt + client attendee list; 2) alcohol is reimbursable for client meals but requires attendee names and business purpose. Tipping is fine up to 25%.
Elena M: Quick Q on splitting: should I submit entire $312.45 under one expense or split line items for food vs alcohol vs tip?
Maya L: Submit one expense with an itemized breakdown in the notes for easier audit: food $187.45, alcohol $75.00, tip $50.00. Upload the receipt and paste client contact/email if possible.
Elena M: Got it. Also, do we need the corporate card decline evidence? I have the merchant app screenshot saying "DECLINED" and our card last 4 digits previously used.
Sam T: Yes please attach the decline screenshot — we use that to trigger a card review with the issuer. If the issuer had an auth hold, they sometimes reverse any temporary charges.
Expenses Bot: Reminder — upload receipt, decline screenshot, attendee list under category `meals/client`. To request fast-track, add tag `EXP-FAST` in the expense title. Missing attendee list will delay approval.
Elena M: Filed EXP-4452, marked EXP-FAST, attached receipt + decline screenshot + attendee list (client: K. Nguyen, A. Patel). Note says: client kickoff dinner, product spec review.
Maya L: Thanks Elena. Finance will review and aim to reimburse within 3 business days for EXP-FAST. We'll also open an issuer inquiry about the declined transaction.
Jon R: FYI if this keeps happening at that venue we should add a secondary backup card to travel kit.
Elena M: Thanks all — appreciate the fast help :thumbsup:
Maya L: We'll confirm once reimbursement posts and update EXP-4452 status. If anyone else sees decline at POS please ping @Sam T directly.
